SUPER VACATION 的中文是 「美亞假期」

非常非常爛的旅行社。我們一家人參加了 西雅圖-溫哥華-惠斯勒-洛磯山脈的8日遊 

行程第一天 預定12點在機場集合  巴士1:30才到。

後來旁敲側擊才發現 這家旅行社 同時在溫哥華安排了 西雅圖一日遊。

所以司機兼導遊 是同一個人 而且他從早上5點起床 載了溫哥華的旅客來西雅圖 逛了一個早上跟中午。（所以我們西雅圖的人才要等到溫哥華的人早上行程都玩完了 才能上車）

上車後 又在西雅圖晃了三個小時 接回從溫哥華來的旅客 還要我們陪他們繼續參觀西雅圖。

司機沿路邊開車邊解說。非常的不安全。而且司機一個人 需要同時照顧整團20多人的旅客。包含簽到點名 行李搬到巴士上。（我們坐的是20人座的小巴士 非常不舒服！）

由此可見 此家旅行社 對於自家員工也是非常苛刻的。
最讓人擔心的事。這位司機兼導遊大哥。一早五點起床。要一路忙到 晚上9點。這對於旅客的安全是不負責任的！

非常不推薦任何人參加任何此公司的團！

They found my wallet here and took nothing but the tip I gave them. I did not have much money in it but I did have cards. I will forever be grateful to the staff that work here and will suck up any food both literally and figuratively.

Finally a reason to quit going here: completely crushed 
OR's and management that thinks I made the entire thing up. Yeah, I'm done with this place . Too bad. No more quick burger fixes for me.
Still a great ff cheeseburger and onion rings--for Can. standards, at least.
Cooked by an 82 year old ukr/Hungarian  mama.  Makes me miss my grandma. Also makes this quite a tough sell, unfortunately.
What a cool little find! They actually have cottage cheese perogies and sausage. Free parking out front until three...hopefully b4 rushhour

Friendly ladies in a familiar looking spa. Five dollars to remove some shellac and they automatically expect you to tip on top of the extra charge plus tax. So almost fifty dollars for a basic pedi when all is said and done.
It's soggy in the middle as the neapolitan style goes, and it's tasty, but it's just ok, too.
Way too busy to get in on a Saturday but perhaps no worse than anywhere else.
Cute place for take-out but just too packed to make me want to linger. Wonder how long the fad will last?
Trying to get the $5 dollar check in card is equivalent to the wait at the border over a long weeked. Still waiting after 3 weeks. So done!!
Friendly customer service but the store is so small that they don't even have shoes which are oftentimes nicer than their bags.
Best place in Van to get flowers except they did not give me flower food or offer a card. Their system is painfully slow but I appreciated the customer service and beautiful bouquet.
This Safeway sucks but the customer service manager on weekdays is soo nice. It's not his fault that they are understaffed...at least I don't think it is.
Great service but just order basics as food is average.

They updated their packaging for travel; I appreciate that they took my tip and paid the extra for a customer's convenience. Nicest proprietor ever. Pad Thai noodles still thinner than those to which I am accustomed, but pretty good overall. I would return! 3.5 stars
They don't use authentic Thai noodles, but the Pad Thai was not bad. Beware of sauce that seeps through your bag if you order take out since it ruined my bag. They should use plastic!
Don't expect to be served your meals at the same time so u should like what your friend orders.  Quite disappointing.
Bob rectified my terrible shrimp pad Thai with chicken and is becoming my go-to Thai place. Thx, Bob!

Pad Thai was soaked in vinegar, no peanuts, no bean sprouts--and I ordered a veggie version. It was inedible and soup like. Live and learn. Extremely disappointed! This is what happens when you order out of convenience. And now that I have gone elsewhere since--good riddance! It's a shame that a culinary city such as Van settles for such a below average restaurant. It truly gets worse every time. Never again!
Solid 3+ stars.
I quit going here when I could not make out what the mystery meat was in my pad Thai. It's a shame as I once enjoyed it here.

Great service and food. Unfortunately, the entire table could not hear each other due to the music and the speakers, just as other reviews suggested.
It was so bad that the server also couldn't hear us and my ears hurt a lot the next day. I doubt I will ever come here again for that reason, even as someone who has tolerated  many a loud concert and night club in my time. Since I tipped well and spent a lot for the group, I expected to be able to hold a conversation. Disappointing.
Worst meal and earls I've ever visited. Awful chili chicken, too. Don't go here if u can help it.

Way better than Lucky's! Get the double chocolate cake type or whatever is hot out of the oven--usually the honey glazed. Addictive and amazing! The icing does not easily unstick either, unlike those "amateur" shops. I am becoming too American I guess....
King suite with martini mix and $40 breakfast credit is best deal and hippest hotel in the city.
Not a bad place; long wait with few customers as others suggested. Friendly service. The roll with seared salmon and garlic was odd. Solid 3-3.5 stars.
Service slow, food very average, but great for groups. Perfect patio. Really dry burgers here. Don't get sucked in because of the patio! Not really worth it!

Amazing brunch place! Did not get a photo since I was so hungry. The omelettes were only two eggs but delicious and they serve 49th parallel--the best! Mochas were the same price as lattes, too. I am a fan! Brunch for two was almost $60 tho so definitely on the steep side!

Always a friendly, casual place with a nice professional door guy. Guilt and Company could learn a lot about customer service from this place. Unfortunately, wine selection has gone downhill. Too bad.
Get the pot pie with mash and the rose wine. Still an awesome cas. place, even hallowe'en weekend.
Vince has to be the nicest proprietor ever and promptly answered any question that I had about caffeine and acidity. Makes me like the coffee even more!
Don't come after three. I checked in and they r gone. I so needed some soup. ;( where to go?
U could really share one. I dropped 1/2 my sandwich, chips and pickle and they gave me a new pickle!
Amazing homemade pepperoni. Can't wait to try the turkey roll.
No new mags or polish. $35 shellac mani.
The wait is too long even if you book. Believe it or not, they're the best in this 'hood.

My Christmas tree is a West Elm tree. So cute!!! And they donate proceeds from their adorable  animal decorations, made in Nepal to the SPCA. So that means I need to buy even more. Too bad the sales people won't get off the phone long enough to help, tho!
Buns aren't too bad when hot, but I just ate a raw, hardened peanut butter cookie. Yucky! Lentil soup was the best of all three items.
Buns while tasty also tasted old to me. Not sure where I went wrong.
Enjoy a soda on the patio on a nice day.
Not a destination place. Good watering hole only if you live within walking distance. Watch out for nasty debris on your glass. Yuck.
Nicest manager and server ever--I am a fan!

Ok, this place is five stars all the way. Order lingcod fish and chips, dairy free clam chowder to go which is awesome on a cold day, and Vancouver Island root beer to stay local. Yum. It's Vancouver's new number one fish and chips spot and it is as good as In-N-Out in SoCal, but with fish. Also, one piece is not enough, especially when the fish is this good. And mine lasted on the drive home, too. But the number one reason to go is the friendly proprietor, Robert. Just do it.

They charge five dollars extra to remove shellac which I've never heard of before. Nice girls, moderate massage second time here, and five dollars pricier than anywhere else.  Shellac only lasts eight days tho, sadly.
Vancouver's best new resto--no question.
Get the Asian inspired calamari and the oyster shots, ESP if u don't particularly love oysters.

I thought my standards had fallen. It's just not great here but when getting fast take out the sign drew me in. A plate of tuna, salmon and Cali roll for $7.10 plus tip. Not bad but you get what you pay for I guess. 2.5 stars.

Not the best experience with this hotel this time around although the staff was very nice. Unfortunately my room which was next to the elevator, did not allow for any sleep. Maybe next time they should try to place chatty conference guests in the noisier rooms?

My trip went from a 2 star to a 5 and it's become my fave place to stay in Van. It has the best patio in the entire city and is also in the best location and many people seem to overlook that. View from my room if you can be so lucky.
Beware of the smelly dog rooms that the maids deny r used for dogs! If u get tile it's a dog room! Friendly staff tho.
Delicious food, lovely staff, talented chef
They are sampling warm American beer and Michelob light, or as one guy put it, "girly beer."
Google says this place is dt on Hastings and it's not. Don't believe them. Boo.
At least the staff upstairs are friendly.
Actually quite clean in emerge which is impressive.
Absolutely awful. Impossible to hear a word. Drinks average. Food worse.  I won't be back. I never give one star but this could be it.
Uh oh. Wine and mixed don't mix but how can one resist this drink menu, really? Just do it. Cake looks divine. Dip is yum!
Two pieces of Id are needed now and if you return with one person they won't let you in.  Why do I bother? I guess because the bartenders are nice and the music is good.
Way more fun than rodney's

Just refused entry from a manager 1/2 my age because I forgot my dl and I truly thought that I had it. It was pouring rain and he was an extremely rude man. The place was not full. I could easily prove to any po entering the place that I'm not underage. No wonder this city sucks so much for nightlife.
Prices here keep going up. Self check out takes waaaay longer even if you know what you are doing. annoying.
No skim milk in commuda once again. If I didn't have a gc to this store I would never shop here again. Even iga is starting to look good.

They took down my photo of the iceberg lettuce salad priced at $10. Pretty shady on Yelp's behalf. I have never had that happen before. Unless they have changed drastically, I would stay far away.  I spared them the one star review. Try Bob's or Aree if you must eat Thai in this Thai-less city. Or skip it entirely and go south.

Very nice proprietor and sadly, a shady business I discovered. Pad Thai = no sauce, no tamarind and no ketchup. nothing. $13. Side salad made of iceberg lettuce. $10. No credit to my credit card, either. Grrrr. You could not pay me to eat here again. Only the spring rolls were decent. I doubt it will last long. Place was empty, too, and now I know why.

Unfortunately, the pad Thai was made with ketchup which I should have known since the menu stated it was made with a "sweet sauce". No tamarind in site, but if you don't believe me, try it yourself. The salad consisted of shredded iceberg lettuce with a few cukes and tomatos thrown on top and was priced at ten dollars. I could have found better salad at MacDonald's across the street. I will not return.
Great new place on Main. Order the sausage special; skip the too fatty pork belly. Desserts looked divine! Servers great but service far too slow.
Don't expect any kind of foot massage or any recent magazines and you are fine.
Took Almost two hours to dry and still smudged. ;(  They seem to have improved a bit.
Snotty and cold environment which is par for the course, I guess. Doubt I'll be back, even if I was spending $$$$.
Pretty good, very cheap sushi! No wonder it's always packed!
Phone ticketing is so painful and just not worth it sadly, even if you are organized. Sometimes, I miss the simpler, older days. Bouncers were really nice however.
Nicest baristas after four today!
Woah! Garbage on floor and tables and slightly uppity counter staff today. Not cool for sb.
If one more person boxes me in while parking in a 'non-parking' zone I will back into their car.
Seems to be the vpd hangout to ticket unsuspecting cyclists $108 for riding on the sidewalk on extremely busy burrard. Boo.
Worst nachos and food in the city. Makes Earls, Cactus and Joeys look like Cioppinos. Even Browns is better.
Another check in offer that I didn't see. Great, authentic Montreal bagels you don't find in OC!
All of the cookie sandwiches are way too sweet with way too much icing. Cookies would be way better plain. I was disappointed.
Limited wine selections by the glass; Flatbread pizza is good. Pasta was spicy and tasty but  did not taste homade.

Their sandwiches are all great; the pain au chocolat is about as meh as anywhere else. Macarons are hit and miss depending on how fresh they are. Customer service is surprisingly good and the iced lattes aren't bad at all but pricey given the area.
Looks better than it tastes, all in all.  Chocolate cream puff pretty good; coffee burnt and not so great.
Fatty pork with way too much sauce, small portions of noodles when noodles are cheap, soggy egg roll with very little sauce and no fortune cookie. Not cool; take a pass.
Great place for greeting cards surprisingly, all holidays to be found but no cards specifically for Grandmas!
$25 dollars of carefully chosen goods and they don't accept MC. No signage anywhere. Never heard of that in this day and age. I usually use visa but brought my US MC in error. ;(
I'm a veggie wannabe. Give it a go!
Breakfast is still amazing here, especially the French toast and green juice. Benny inevitably arrives cold which is disappointing.
While I still enjoy this restaurant, the fact that they won't let you taste a wine before trying it is lame. Skip the pizza bread as it's just not good and extremely overpriced.
Nicest proprietor and staff ever. Amazing, welcoming and warm atmosphere. Packed but not overly so. Love the art here. Tastefully decorated down to the espresso bar. Welcome to the 'hood.
Try as many wine flights as you can handle but maybe skip the red. Order everything that we did! Lovely.
Great staff; mediocre food at best.
Great patio!
Great wine, oysters, fried chicken, seafood and salads. Pecan pie was the best dessert; beignets and red velvet cake were not fresh. Recommended when visiting van!

Not impressed with huge lunch lines. It's not rocket science that u need more people at lunch, bmo! Ugh. 

Update- Teller was so nice today but seemed to know less about her hidden fees than I do. Shows how much they really "snow" us in the end!
Amazing tourist stop in my own city. Hipster Portolaesque shop without the attitude. Love the reclaimed, old growth fir countertops.

Good food but service fell short at both the beginning and end. My coq au vin plate was served cold, sadly, which is not great for gravy. While they apologized and offered to make me another meal, eating it after everyone else was not the most enjoyable, even if I opted to have them reheat it. Delicious, rich food.
Cute place; friendly proprietor who hails directly from France. Delicious latte. Exquisite quiche and pastries.
Turned out to be a nice day to announce the new premier and her executive council. Flash mob at cc, too.
Friendly but rigid about exchanges of brand new goods. Lame.

Great coffee and only place worth purchasing it on the island. Must remember that the iced mocha
is better.
Hot chocolate sweet and yuck. Sb is actually better for that! Or Murchies.
One of Vancouver's east side's finest roasters. Get the east side roast but all are good. Friendly service. They don't filter their water because Vancouver has the best water in the world!
Short ribs and potatoes r great for heartier eaters! Nice ambiance; nicer waitress.

No wireless on weekends until after four. I am never a "sit in a shop all day and surf the web with just one coffee purchase kinda person," but is it a dick move or smart move? A bit of both, perhaps? Trying out the new chocolate chip cookie dough doughnut after being advised of its  heaviness; so heavy, in fact that it's packed in a cupcake box.

$35 for coffee. Hope it's laced with something' good.  
:)
Still the best overall, coffee place in town in my books. Now all of my sb experiences are blah. It doesn't hurt that the doughnuts rock, either.

Would not credit me on the tax for a return. Is that even legal? Will avoid this Tiffany like the plague in the future. Wanted to charge me for earring backings; waived in the US stores when making a purchase. Go south instead.
Not worth the time, money or effort. If you love Tiffany as much as I do, simply go south. An embarrassment to my citizenship. Everything is such an effort here. Too bad as it's so convenient.

Since this store opened I am waiting for the lid of the coffin to close on the bay. Unfortunately, selection is not 1/2 as good as SoCal, but then again it was
impossible to get close enough to any department to truly judge. Still the customer service continues to deliver.  The manager who goes out of his way to answer everyone's review is just another reason to shop here over any other department store. I am disappointed that I can't use my US nordstrom or points card here, however.

Best customer service of any department store I have ever shopped at. They delivered my shoes. Liz is the bomb. I have never seen anything like it. It is even better than the US and I am still in shock by the amazing treatment I have received here. I could be a spokesperson for them I am that impressed. Now read my reviews for Holt and the Bay. May I never have to set foot in either store again. Please start carrying David Yurman  jewelry, Nordstrom!

Although I was disappointed by the booties in the shoe dep't. today I had great customer service from a humble associate (wish I could remember her name, but she was pretty and Asian). It was packed due to the sale but I was served almost immediately. Too bad the new style is the "Vancouver wet toe" look. Umm, I lived that for most of my life; I think I will take a pass.
The pad Thai was a sad disappointment.
Never book through email at this salon as inevitably they will give you the incorrect date and you won't be able to get your hair done here, anyway!
Nakry and Charmaine are the best!
They book up too fast now. ;(
Impossible to get Friday appt's after 3, sadly.
Wonderful customer service! Great sandwiches and salad and iced coffees looked good and not lined up like SB.
Shane is great for blondes and other cuts! Wish he gave a longer head massage tho.
Sale time...but it's never in what you want to buy!
customer service for just a drink even if bar area is too small; will have to try the food altho nothing seemed to appeal.
Always packed but friendly service. People reward themselves with coffee after the gym I guess.
I gave it a three but I'd never go back. Food is all meh.

Beautiful space just like we would find in Waikiki. $7 pour over for 100% Kona coffee means Hawaiian prices. ;) Love the decor and the cookies look so delicious! Too bad the coffee is $30 a bag. Trust Gary!

Don't go here if you don't have to. Expect a 1 hour wait to be 3 hours on any given day and this is no exaggeration whatsoever. I will say the receptionists have improved and are incredibly kind and patient.
Always like the atmosphere for people watching here but wish they had skim milk.
Always a wait, even with an app't.
Great place to party...for the over 60 set. :p
Shop here for designer funky shoes if you don't have the time to head South. Same stuff; double the price.
Delicious bc pie; cookies just ok and crumbled to touch which was annoying.
Umm. It's not a separate bus. from thr smokehouse. That's why it closes so early and is tuff to find. Weird.
Wow. Did we copy blue ribbon in Ny or what?
Service slow but short rib sandwich and pulled pork Benny are the best in the city!
They don't properly follow their list. Waited over 45 minutes and saw two groups my size who came after me seated before me. Not cool.
Porchetta is the best that I've had and not greasy at all but still has that pork crunch!
Seems like a great place but my one hour massage quickly became forty minutes with talk time. $120.
Whole Foods products at east side prices. Awesome.
Every other place is a three in comparison! Orgasm on a plate on Vday!

Went here in sweats today and was given the "once over look" by a few clerks. Always interesting to be shunned by people making minimum wage. Manager was friendly, however although I noticed they are advertising for another one.

Customer service has really improved here, and with our low dollar, for the first time I choose to do my shopping here over the U.S. The weekday manager is exceptional, too and selection also seems to have improved although the sale rack is still something to be desired. Too bad they only price match within two weeks as inevitably your item will be 2/3 off and you are stuck paying full price!
The meters ate $2.25 worth of my quarters. Only pay by cc.

Food is delicious here even if sandwiches are teeny tiny. Cookies are so good and addicting and you should buy all or none. They are "that" good. Staff is kind but somewhat forgetful after you order something.
Amazing sushi. Good prices.
No new mags past August. Seriously, my doctor does better. Nice girls and space, but sadly they did not ask me to remove my earring during massage and I lost one. Not cool and a bit unprofessional.

I've now had two terrible take out experiences here (one with cold food, the other with a bill with added extras that I did not notice) so I am afraid I'll be passing by here the next little while, even if the food is still good.
Yummy pizza and exceptional calamari. Got my free dessert with check in. Tiramisu actually pretty good.  Waiter was slow but nice.
Closed for lunch contrary to regular hours listed.
Pizza was too soggy this time and the service stopped when I told him to add a 20% tip for effort.
Too bad; no check in offer for take out...wait time is 40 minutes too so you really gotta love this place. Not sure if it's worth the wait.
Receptionist is not the sharpest knife in the drawer. Not recommended.
Saturday lunch on my own private patio. All this place needs is a water view, except then it would have a five hour wait.
Closed for a private party for old dudes in suits. What a surprise for the GH.
I can't believe that I was the first to review this and as a five star. I would no longer waste my time here. Sad.

Place doesn't seem like anything special.  It is so dead early in the night that they try to lure you in for a free fruit punch which is god awful. Oh well, I think it must be fun for the twenty-somethings in the city.
I forgot how great the mini-burgers are here. Vancouver's Misfit.

Impressive
customer
service
here.
Stupidest mall ever. Passport office here makes it worse. Parking is a buck every ten minutes.
Omg. The reviews are all true. They didn't even give me my combo price and charged me $2.80 for a small water, then 80 cents for each cookie
I might add my two subs were Twenty bucks and one was a six inch!! It's misleading as u suddenly feel like a tourist being scammed!

Service much improved by all baristas but one hipster dude with glasses who doesn't smile and acts like he is too cool to serve you. I love both the coffee and treats, especially the chocolate chip cookies, peanut butter cups and vegan chocolate chip cookie. My new fave place! You won't be disappointed with anything here and make sure you tip them! I just hope that everyone stays pleasant as I really want this place to stay!
They get coffee from Edmonton, Calgary and Timbertrain. Trying out Timbertrain beans since they are the best coffee shop in town!

Looked cute but a weird lack of seating and unfriendly barista who was too cool made me take a pass. Maybe I
I'll return but why bother? Management should take a good look at their staff and layout if they don't want this place to go the same way of the former. Also, once again contrary to Yelp hours it is certainly not closed today.
If the wait is too long just go to Campagonolo. Trust me; you won't be disappointed.
Manager threatened me with a lawsuit over my review. Never again. Stay far away. I am sorry that he was so offended by my taste buds.
The gelato here is quite tasty.
Unfortunately the cardboard crust makes this place a fail. The gelato was good, tho.
Forgot how uncomfortable the seating is in here. They seem to wonder why one goes to the till to order. Well, why not, when it's so packed? Not even a spot to place your coat which is quite annoying.
Chocolates here are both amazing and pricey.
Loud!!!!! Decent music. Ears still ringing, tho.
Great place for greeting cards surprisingly, all holidays but no cards specifically for Grandmas!
Get the fresh chocolate chip cookies. Macaroons r just ok.

The pizza and
blueberry breads are sooo good,  esp. when freshly baked!
I admit I like their cookie dough for a hefty price and heftier butt. Ha.
Worst noodles ever. Would not recommend or return. Don't get the hype at all!
Weird I had tried to tip here and couldn't. Marc D you did it again!
Worst pizza ever. Don't go here, even when craving pizza and when there doesn't seem to be anywhere better.
Burgers are actually really yummy!
Just paid almost $5 for a flat soda. Friendly service but terrible otherwise. Never again. So done with this place, even if it always seems appealing at the time.
No booze. Boo. Good pizza. Another lady's bag slung into me? Not so much. Too small to eat in. Good for take-away, I imagine.

Terrible return policy. Just wait until Nordstrom opens up dt. Say goodbye to a Canadian institution and the signature four colour stripes if they don't pull their socks up. I say good riddance! At least the sales lady was nice but that still won't salvage them.
Slowest customer service ever.
The only fake reviews are probably given by those with few reviews warning that they are fake. Still a great cuppa joe and service is fine.
Nice and cozy but nothing like main of course. Lucky's soon to follow in the old Kits' coffee spot. Yahoo.
Insanely overpriced store for everything but blue ruby jewelry, ironically. Nothing under $150, even T shirts start at this price. Lines such as Rag and Bone and Joie are nice of course.
Great place but I should not have to down a quart of water after eating a salad!
Great deep house music! Stu is the nicest proprietor, too! Look for the tall dude with his tall friends!
Unlike the agents in Oc, the ones here are rude and miserable, just as I would expect from yvr. There is a reason I left this cold place, and I am not talking about the weather.

Sitting in front of an exit row on WJ is worse than the worst rouge flight but it was either that or sit at the back. Thanks air miles! So not worth it!! Also, be very careful. This is one of my only yelo reviews ever filtered as I gave them the low star rating they deserve! Shady!!!
Lines so huge today. I miss ralphs and tjs. I just paid 4 times the amount for organic and had to back out of the lot to park around the corner, too!
Friendly service by every manager. Really impressed by that. No parking ever so I park down the street. Even more $$$$ than WF. Doesn't come close to whole foods with choices, either.
This is the one inside Indigo and it's not as small as the one next to Vij's.
Great ideas even for small gardens or pots!

Great service and I have been quite happy with the way that I was treated here. I am glad that I found these guys as they really saved me. A special thanks to Brian, the manager. I'm glad I found a reliable place.
If you are looking for them, Apollo is no longer part of their name; they are Speedy and they are located next to the cool Vintage car shop.

Sandwiches and hot chocolate are great altho they tend to overdo it with the sun dried tomatoes which overpower the rest.  They do use authentic chocolate, however. The monkey bread, as wonderful as it looks is just too heavy and rich-- I would skip it next time!

Wonderful sandwiches and mixed mocha (milk and dark) hot chocolate. Only tried a taste of the monkey bread but yum!         

Like moist banana bread with chocolate.
Quiche is delicious and buttery; better than the sandwiches. I so wanted the monkey bread. Next time!
Newest neighbourhood watering hole with pasta. Food not offered past 11 pm.

John is awesome, honest and fair and they won't upsell you. The only downfall is they don't give you a rental but spend the day on commercial and save yourself the $300 you would pay at your dealership.
Worst mall ever compared to any US store. Terrible customer service everywhere you go. The Bay cosmetics seem quite reasonable here, tho and when I can find deals on stuff they do in a pinch.
$70 to watch your child play on a mail truck (2 adults and one senior).
15 min massage is 35 bucks with tip. Yikes!
Cutest park ever and only recently did I learn of its name.  I have seen a few weddings set up here and it's just perfect for that too!
Love their desserts from here, especially the lemon tart or chocolate mousse cakes. The pain de chocolat is amazing, too.
Great sardines, chorizo and prawns. Needs better ambiance or some background music at least.
gong show! But I paid fifty dollars extra in spite of my nexus. Hopefully it will last the next ten years as they finally realized we don't change much in five!

Worst customer service ever. Checkout machines that shut down midway thru your order and cashier won't give you $1 back in cash from a gift card so you are stuck with a card with a mere dollar left. Seems like the staff needs better training on common sense and customer service. Avoid if you can.
Worst pad Thai. Don't expect to find more than three shrimp if you order it with your pad Thai, either.
Last time I was here the raspberry tart didn't taste as fresh, but the place had a warmer vibe. Not sure why they can't offer more mini-tart flavours. Seems like a tough business to try to establish.
Try the savoury feta pepper. Get it heated!
Baristas don't know how to add Sb cards to your phone card so you don't get the points if you are registered. Fail. Too many issues at this one.
Service is improving here. Yay.
Great music and dangerous bartender, Ryan!
Terrible, terrible service second time. Treated like a second rate citizen, almost. Prob. won't return.
They call me and email me to ensure I make my app't and then they keep me waiting.
bK really knows his stuff! Go here!
Others might look prettier or be more exotic but these are the tastiest for peanut butter fingers!
Average prices. Average stripping. The economy version of all brazilans.
I have no idea why but I like their turkey and cheese chemical sandwich when in a bind for some non-sweets. You can even get it with a star if you've had too much coffee.
This one is way better than the one on gran and 11th. Ponytail barista is the nicest and coolest guy there esp when u have a discount. He gave me what I wanted so I am a definite fan!
Most expensive blowouts in the city at $46-$48 with tip. Really disappointed as I was looking forward to trying it out!
Told me they had a stylist available when mine called in sick and then they cancel on the offer. Really disappointing. Sounds like a cool place; too bad I will never know.
Wonderful pedi at $75. Like my own private spa. Wish the massage was stronger tho.
Love the breakie but don't get anything with hollandaise. I tried to order it on the side as it's just too rich. They refuse to keep it heated so they just serve it stone cold. Bizarro.
Decent burger and Cobb salad.
The guys at the counter are actually really nice even if my pizza always arrives cold. ;(

Brs are so gross;
Worse than the worst airport. Nice to see I have a cute young resident not a day over twenty. Makes for an interesting end to my vacay. Arrived 930 am and no one is a available until 3. Canada healthcare, hard at work. The nurse was quite kind and the young doctor tried at least.
This place sells Earnest ic and the best peanut butter cookies. It's so good that I can't return now. Darn.
The line up of idiots with lost licenses, no i.d. and no clue starts here! Bring reading material when you renew.

I am mystified by the popularity of this place; worst smelling products out there but this store is packed! Yet the customer service is top notch. Very Vancouvery place. Natural remedies re-branded. Clever marketing.
Nice space but no room to sit. Odd layout which prevents a larger seating area. Too bad for me.
I guess you need resos here even if it doesn't say anything about it on yelp or their website. Good to know, but new businesses such as these really need to work on their communication skills!
Friendly and accommodating service. I'm a fan!
And so I eat my words. The bacon turkey sandwich is yummy in a jam and better than SB, admittedly.
